senses.gloss: m. (v. שְׁמִינִי) Shamin, a coin, one eighth of an Italian Isar (As).
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 12a:10">Kidd. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>שתי פרוטות לש׳</he> the Shamin has two P’ruṭahs; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 5:12">Tosef. B. Bath. V, 12</cite> <he>לשמן</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>לשווין</he>, corr. acc.); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:1:24">Y. Kidd. I, 58ᵈ</cite> <he>שני פרוטות שמין</he>.—Pl. <cite ref="U01509"><he>שְׁמֹנִין</he></cite>. Kidd. l. c. <he>שני ש׳ להנץ</he> two Shamins make one Hannets (v. <cite ref="E00691"><he>הַנֵּץ</he></cite>); Tosef. l. c.; Y. Kidd. l. c. <he>שני שמין ניצים</he> (corr. acc.).
